SELECT month AS "month", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount END), 0) AS "income", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount END), 0) AS "expense",
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN entry_date >= #{openingDate} AND TRUE THEN CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE -amount END END), 0) AS "balanceNet" FROM ( SELECT AS month, entry_date, type, amount FROM ledger_entry WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND entry_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ) t GROUP BY month

SELECT category_id AS "id", month AS "month", SUM(amount) AS "amount" FROM ( SELECT AS month, category_id, amount FROM ledger_entry WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND entry_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ) t GROUP BY category_id, month

SELECT payment_method_id AS "id", month AS "month", SUM(amount) AS "amount" FROM ( SELECT AS month, payment_method_id, amount FROM ledger_entry WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND entry_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ) t GROUP BY payment_method_id, month

SELECT COALESCE(c.group_name, c.name) AS "label", SUM(e.amount) AS "amount" FROM ledger_entry e JOIN category c ON c.id = e.category_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.type = 'EXPENSE' AND e.entry_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY COALESCE(c.group_name, c.name) ORDER BY SUM(e.amount) DESC
